Child mortality
```{r mort}
cildmort <- read.csv2("child-mortality.csv", encoding = "UTF-8",sep=",",header = TRUE)
```

```{r scatter-raw}

     ylab = "Kindersterblichkeit Weltweit" )

```
Show child mortality by country or continent

```{r scatter}
# select country (just change the name)
country_name <- "Africa"
#country <- subset(joineddata, Entity == country_name)
country <- subset(cildmort, Entity == country_name )


plot(country$Year, country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected., col = "red",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Child mortality", main = country_name)


```

```{r scatter}

# alle Länder
country <- cildmort

# Grundplot mit allen Daten
plot(country$Year,
     country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.,
     type = "n",
     xlab = "Year",
     ylab = "Value",
     main = "All countries")

# Länder bestimmen
countries <- unique(country$Entity)

# Für jedes Land eine eigene Linie
for (i in seq_along(countries)) {
  
  data_country <- subset(country, Entity == countries[i])
  
  lines(data_country$Year,
        data_country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.,
        col = i)
}

# Legende
#legend("topright",
 #      legend = countries,
  #     col = seq_along(countries),
   #    lty = 1,
    #   cex = 0.5)


identify(country$Year,
         country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.,
         labels = paste(country$Entity, country$Year, sep = " - "))

```


```{r scatter} 
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)


# Alle Länder 
  country <- cildmort 

# Y-Variable in numerisch umwandeln
  y_values <-as.numeric(as.character(country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.))
  
  #country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected. <-
  #as.numeric(as.character(country$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.))


# Daten nach Land und Jahr sortieren 
  country <- cildmort %>% 
    arrange(Entity, Year)
  


  # Interaktiver Plot 
  fig <- plot_ly( country, 
                  x = ~Year, 
                  y = y_values, 
                  color = ~Entity, 
                  text = ~paste( 
                    "Land:", Entity, 
                    "<br>Jahr:", Year, 
                    "<br>Wert:", y_values ), 
                  hoverinfo = "text", 
                  type = "scatter", 
                  mode = "lines+markers" ) 
  
  fig <- fig %>% 
    layout( 
      xaxis = list(title = "Year"), 
      yaxis = list(title = "Value"), 
      title = "Under-five mortality rate" ) 
  fig
```
Child mortality in 2024

```{r recent-filtered}
recentmort <- dplyr::filter(cildmort,Year==2024)
```

Countries with the highest child mortality

```{r recent-extreme}
extreme <- recentmort[
  recentmort$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected. > 5,
]

extreme
```
Sorted with the highest rates first:

```{r recent-extreme}
extreme <- recentmort[
  as.numeric(recentmort$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.) > 5,
]

extreme <- extreme[
  order(
    as.numeric(extreme$Under.five.mortality.rate..selected.),
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
]

extreme
```
